title: MV Gui
description: Simple GUI for Multiverse worlds, perfect for new players
body:
🧭 MV GUI Helper
📖 Overview

MV GUI Helper is a simple and user-friendly plugin that adds a GUI menu for navigating worlds created with Multiverse.

⚠️ Note: This plugin is NOT made by Multiverse-Core developers.
It is an independent addon designed to make Multiverse easier to use — especially for new players.

✨ Features
🧭 Clean GUI world selector
⚡ Easy teleport between worlds
🎮 Beginner-friendly interface
🧩 Works alongside Multiverse-Core
🔒 Permission support
🚀 Lightweight and fast
👶 Perfect for New Players

Instead of using commands like:

/mvtp world

Players can simply:

/mvgui

…and choose a world from a menu!

📦 Requirements
Multiverse-Core
Paper / Spigot
📜 Commands
/mvgui - Open the world GUI
🔐 Permissions
mvgui.admin - Access the GUI
⚠️ Disclaimer

This plugin is not affiliated with or developed by the Multiverse-Core team.
It is simply a helper plugin to improve usability.

💬 Support

Need help or found a bug?
Contact me or open an issue on the project page.

🚀 Why use this?
No command memorizing
Better player experience
Cleaner server navigation
